Payment and project terms

Clear terms, agreed up front.

  • 50% deposit before development begins.
  • Remaining 50% payable before final handover or launch.
  • You own your domain name.
  • GitHub source code is handed over once the project is fully paid.
  • Revisions: two rounds for Starter, three for Professional and Premium.
  • Additional functionality and major changes are quoted separately.
  • Monthly hosting is optional and billed in advance.
  • Hosting cancellation and website migration are subject to agreed notice and handover terms.

FAQ

Good questions.

Do I have to pay £25 a month?

No. The fully managed service is optional. Without it, you receive your complete source code through GitHub and choose your own hosting provider.

Do I own my website?

Yes. Once the project is fully paid, your complete source code is handed over through GitHub, and you always own your domain name.

How do I pay?

A 50% deposit before development begins, and the remaining 50% before final handover or launch. The managed service is billed monthly in advance.

What is GEO?

Generative Engine Optimisation: structuring your website so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers understand your business and recommend it. It's included in Premium.

Is there anything else to pay?

Only your domain registration, plus any premium third-party services or extra work you choose to add, all quoted before anything starts.
